BiblicalUsage: Ephroach is the young of birds — the brood in the nest. The law says if you take the young, let the mother go, that it may be well with you; the eagle's young suck up blood where the slain are; and the sparrow finds a house and the swallow a nest for her young, even at God's altars.
TheologicalSignificance: God's care reaches the smallest nest, and His law protects even the mother bird. I believe the young birds preach tenderness written into the commandments: the God who feeds the eagle's young has not forgotten mine.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; God's Provision; Compassion
